name: Call Him Daddy
source:
Going back to university is easy when you have someone to keep your mind off the school stuff! But, is that enough for you? Once accidental encounter will turn your life upside down and make you question everything. Dare to try something new!

[From in-app]
translation:
当有人让你不再去想学校的事情时，回到大学就很容易了！但是，这对你来说足够了吗？一次偶然的邂逅会让你的生活发生翻天覆地的变化，让你质疑一切。敢于尝试新事物！

[来自应用程序内]
